title_km: លីមីតសនិទាន (ការដាក់ជាផលគុណកត្តារាង 0/0)

exercises.technique_km: ប្រើរូបមន្តផលដកការេពីរតួ x^2 - 4 = (x - 2)(x + 2) រួចសម្រួលកត្តា (x + 2)
exercises.technique_en: Factor numerator as difference of squares (x - 2)(x + 2), cancel (x + 2)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយកជាផលដកការេ (x - 3)(x + 3) និងទាញ x ជាកត្តារួមនៅភាគបែង រួចសម្រួល (x - 3)
exercises.technique_en: Factor numerator as (x - 3)(x + 3) and denominator as x(x - 3), cancel (x - 3)

exercises.technique_km: ប្រើផលដកគូប x^3 - 1 = (x - 1)(x^2 + x + 1) និងផលដកការេ x^2 - 1 = (x - 1)(x + 1) រួចសម្រួល (x - 1)
exercises.technique_en: Factor difference of cubes in numerator and difference of squares in denominator, cancel (x - 1)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយកជាផលគុណកត្តា (x - 2)(x + 3) រួចសម្រួល (x - 2)
exercises.technique_en: Factor numerator as (x - 2)(x + 3), cancel (x - 2)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយក (x - 1)(x + 1) និងភាគបែង (x + 1)(x + 2) រួចសម្រួល (x + 1)
exercises.technique_en: Factor (x - 1)(x + 1) over (x + 1)(x + 2), cancel (x + 1)
Factor x^4 - 16 = (x - 2)(x + 2)(x^2 + 4), cancel (x + 2)
Factor quartic numerator and cubic denominator, cancel (x - 1)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយក (x + 1)(2x - 3) និងភាគបែងផលបូកគូប (x + 1)(x^2 - x + 1) រួចសម្រួល (x + 1)
exercises.technique_en: Factor quadratic numerator (x + 1)(2x - 3) and sum of cubes denominator, cancel (x + 1)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយកផលដកគូប (x - 2)(x^2 + 2x + 4) និងភាគបែងផលដកការេ (x - 2)(x + 2) រួចសម្រួល (x - 2)
exercises.technique_en: Factor difference of cubes and difference of squares, cancel (x - 2)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយក (x - 2)(x^2 + 2x + 4) និងភាគបែង (x - 2)(3x + 1) រួចសម្រួល (x - 2)
exercises.technique_en: Factor difference of cubes and quadratic denominator, cancel (x - 2)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយក (x - 2)(x - 3) និងភាគបែង (x - 3)(x + 3) រួចសម្រួល (x - 3)
exercises.technique_en: Factor numerator (x - 2)(x - 3) and difference of squares denominator, cancel (x - 3)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយក (x - 2)(x - 3) រួចសម្រួលកត្តា (x - 2)
exercises.technique_en: Factor numerator as (x - 2)(x - 3), cancel (x - 2)

exercises.technique_km: ទាញ x^2 ជាកត្តារួម x^2(x - a) និងភាគបែង (x - a)(x + a) រួចសម្រួល (x - a)
exercises.technique_en: Factor x^2(x - a) over (x - a)(x + a), cancel (x - a)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយកជាផលដកការេ (x - \sqrt{5})(x + \sqrt{5}) រួចសម្រួល (x - \sqrt{5})
exercises.technique_en: Factor numerator as difference of squares (x - sqrt(5))(x + sqrt(5)), cancel (x - sqrt(5))

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយកជាផលដកការេ (x - \sqrt{3})(x + \sqrt{3}) រួចសម្រួល (x - \sqrt{3})
exercises.technique_en: Factor numerator as difference of squares (x - sqrt(3))(x + sqrt(3)), cancel (x - sqrt(3))

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយកផលបូកគូប (x + 3)(x^2 - 3x + 9) និងភាគបែង (x + 3)(2x - 9) រួចសម្រួល (x + 3)
exercises.technique_en: Factor sum of cubes in numerator and quadratic in denominator, cancel (x + 3)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយក (x - 3)(x + 3)(x^2 + 9) និងភាគបែង x(x - 3)(2x + 1) រួចសម្រួល (x - 3)
exercises.technique_en: Factor numerator as (x - 3)(x + 3)(x^2 + 9) and denominator as x(x - 3)(2x + 1), cancel (x - 3)

exercises.technique_km: ដាក់ភាគយក (x - 2)(5x + 2) និងភាគបែង (x - 2)(x + 2)(x^2 + 4) រួចសម្រួល (x - 2)
exercises.technique_en: Factor numerator (x - 2)(5x + 2) and denominator (x - 2)(x + 2)(x^2 + 4), cancel (x - 2)

exercises.technique_km: ពន្លាតទ្វេធា (x - 2)^3 + 8 = x^3 - 6x^2 + 12x រួចសម្រួល x
exercises.technique_en: Expand (x - 2)^3 + 8 = x^3 - 6x^2 + 12x, cancel x

exercises.technique_km: ពន្លាត (x + 3)^2 - 9 = x^2 + 6x រួចសម្រួលកត្តា x
exercises.technique_en: Expand (x + 3)^2 - 9 = x^2 + 6x, cancel x

exercises.technique_km: ពន្លាតភាគយកបាន -8x^2 - 4x រួចសម្រួល 2x
exercises.technique_en: Expand numerator to -8x^2 - 4x, cancel 2x
Factor numerator by grouping as (x - 3)(x^2 + 1) and denominator as (x - 3)(2x - 1), cancel (x - 3)
Factor (x - 1) via Horner's method or evaluate as derivative ratio f'(1)/g'(1) = 6/11

exercises.technique_km: ប្រើរូបមន្តលីមីតពហុធាដឺក្រេ n គឺ \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{x^n - 1}{x - 1} = n
exercises.technique_en: Apply standard polynomial identity lim_{x->1} (x^n - 1)/(x - 1) = n
Apply derivative definition f'(1)/g'(1) = (100 - 7)/(50 - 5) = 93/45 = 31/15
Apply derivative definition at x = -1 to get 2017/2015
Split into sum of (x^k - 1)/(x - 1), yielding [n(n+1)/2] / [m(m+1)/2]

exercises.prompt_latex: \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{x + x^2 + \dots + x^n - n}{x + x^2 + \dots + x^m - m}
exercises.technique_km: រូបមន្តទូទៅ៖ \sum_{k=1}^n k / \sum_{j=1}^m j = \frac{n(n+1)}{m(m+1)}
exercises.technique_en: General formula: sum_{k=1}^n k / sum_{j=1}^m j = n(n+1)/(m(m+1))
